units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL tests for tenant-scoped export-fidelity counts and construction of the v1 warning report.
units.dependencyDirection: Tests instantiate the real database layer and fidelity service, but only a narrow subset of the counted schema is populated; host capability can skip the entire suite.
units.keyDataModels: Companies, issues, labels, issue-label links, blocker relations, monitor markers and ExportFidelityCounts/Report.
units.lifecycle: Start disposable PostgreSQL; seed two tenants; count selected records; verify isolation; build one report; clean tables and database.
units.testAssessment: The source contains two focused real-database tests. On 2026-08-19 the isolated Vitest command exited successfully but skipped the file and both tests because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable, so no passing claim is made. Seven counted domains remain zero-only and snapshot/failure/determinism cases are absent.
units.designRationale: Use a real schema to catch tenant-predicate drift and ensure human-readable migration warnings reflect source counts.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a reproducible proof that a reviewed export contains exactly the intended responsibility, evidence and governed-data graph, not merely approximate source cardinalities.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT a real-database compatibility suite comparing source snapshot counts/identities/digests against the emitted manifest and restored target, while adapting the two-tenant isolation fixture pattern.
units.responsibilityConflict: The suite does not cover accountable humans, responsibility contracts, approval bindings, evidence/run provenance or authorship preservation even though approvals/activity are counted by the service.
evidence: 916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f Replace host-to-host Cloud Sync with full-fidelity company Import/Export (#10507)
2026-08-19 isolated focused Vitest: 1 file / 2 tests skipped; no passing claim
securityFindings: Only labels, label references, blockers and monitors are populated; approvals, costs, activity, documents, evidence and attachments have no positive tenant-isolation cases.
Host capability silently converts the full suite to skipped, requiring CI policy that treats unsupported critical integration fixtures as visible non-coverage.
No concurrent mutation or repeatable-snapshot case proves all counts describe one source state.

units.function: Collects ten source-table cardinalities for one company and emits a timestamped versioned warning report.
units.dependencyDirection: Server service depends directly on Drizzle, database schema tables and shared warning/report types. It is called as an observational helper rather than owning export selection or serialization.
units.keyDataModels: ExportFidelityCounts for labels, label links, blockers, documents, work products, attachments, approvals, costs, activity and monitors; ExportFidelityReport v1.
units.lifecycle: Launch ten independent count queries concurrently; coerce missing rows to zero; delegate warning construction; stamp current time.
units.testAssessment: The implementation is small and readable, but its focused real-database suite was skipped on this host. Previously completed portability evidence confirms the report participates in a much broader migration flow but does not upgrade these counts into a reconciliation proof.
units.designRationale: Give operators a low-cost inventory of data categories that a migration may omit or treat specially.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must bind export selection, source snapshot, actor/authority, package digest and target reconciliation into one auditable migration record.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as a typed snapshot-bound reconciliation manifest with per-domain identities/digests, selection and loss codes. ADAPT only the explicit tenant predicates and inexpensive count-query technique.
units.responsibilityConflict: Approvals and activity are reduced to anonymous counts; accountable humans, exact actions/digests, evidence, results and source actors cannot be reconstructed from the report.
evidence: 916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f Replace host-to-host Cloud Sync with full-fidelity company Import/Export (#10507)
linked focused test evidence: 1 file / 2 tests skipped on 2026-08-19
securityFindings: Ten independent queries are not bound to one transaction snapshot, so concurrent changes can yield an internally inconsistent report.
The report counts source rows but does not compare emitted or imported rows, detect substitutions, or bind a package digest.
generatedAt makes reports nondeterministic while providing no source revision or database watermark.
Cardinality-only warnings cannot identify exactly which governed records or responsibility evidence will be lost.
